methods.label: Power-of-a-power rule
methods.explanation: When raising a power to a power, multiply the exponents: \(2^6=64\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the integer power-of-a-power rule and evaluates a small integer power.

review.mathematicalCheck: The integer power-of-a-power rule gives \((2^3)^2=2^{3\times2}=2^6=64\). The retained explanation identifies the rule and shows the resulting power and value sufficiently.
review.levelCheck: Uses elementary integer exponent laws and arithmetic, appropriate for the stated textbook scope.
review.methodDistinctness: One sufficient method is included; evaluating \(8^2\) separately is unnecessary.
